confidence_notes: A small 2026 dining sample serves as a proxy for July, with more uncertainty for the three-course meal. Cocktail and wine estimates use local premiums over draft beer, checked against venue prices. Lodging is modeled, with dorm beds the least certain. [Dining index](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Jeonju), [cocktail prices](https://www.diningcode.com/profile.php?rid=uareBKUH4Irz), [wine prices](https://www.diningcode.com/profile.php?rid=4306RqUrgRm5)
comparable_city_reasoning: Gyeongju is a lodging comparator because both cities draw domestic weekend visitors to historic districts and have a mix of guesthouses and mid-range hotels.
